args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never exited Manufactory Nine because they are not dead; rather, they are "still walking in" every hour [2]. The loop lasts slightly less than an hour and resets anyone inside who "can't feel it," causing them to forget the entire turn and live it fresh [2]. When the hour turns, individuals are reset to the threshold and forget they had progressed, such as reaching the candle [3].

Ode Marran can remember the turns because she is able to "hold the deep Facets back," whereas others are reset by the loop [7]. She has been living the same hour for nine years [6] and has watched the shaft fold and unfold a thousand times [7].

The mechanism was triggered when the Lumen Concern dug for lumen and struck "the Whole," which caused time to "catch" and space to fold [5]. This created a "Fold" where space is bent back on itself, making the interior of the building larger than its exterior [4]. Because of this, the building collapsed during the first turn of the loop and has been "coming down" every turn since [5].
